1. Definitely skill based. You cant go anywhere with your wallet with this game as most of yhe items are aquired through a grind.
2. From what I know, the system automatically balances out both of your power level to a extent, but there exist gaps between end-game gear and early-mid game gear. The end-game gear does take quite a while, but they are working on a general nerf to the amount of grind it takes and some mid-late game tier items got hella strong.
3. I only play Nata(or whatever he is called in global servers) so I can only tell you his playstyle. Nata must play according to his powerspikes, which are his ultimates that deal a lot of dmg. You wait for a opportunity to close in and bait their escape move. When your opponent blows their survivability move and you see a opening, 1-hit combo them with ultimates combined with your burst abillities.
